Lemvig is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, with a specific focus on Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. 

Lemvig's data is integrated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, utilizing records from both the Danish Stroke Database (DanStroke) and the National Patient Registry (LPR) [^src1]. This municipal-level breakdown allows for localized quality development and benchmarking across all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. In the report's data tables, Lemvig's specific metrics for stroke events and treatment rates among atrial fibrillation patients are recorded [^src1]. 

Because the available evidence consists of a single tabular mention, no further claims, relationships, or historical timeline events are documented for this entity.
